said.q: Previously owned by three private galleries it was sold to Chester Dale on 9 June 1926. It is now owned by the National Gallery of Art in Washington, D.C., which acquired it with the rest of Dale's collection - it is now on display in section 88.
said.in: “The Banks of the Oise”, CC BY-SA 4.0
